name: Preamble
text: THIS EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is made and entered into as of July ¥, 2005 (the "Effective Date"), by and among Ajuba International, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Ajuba"), Ajuba Solutions (India) Pvt Ltd (“Ajuba India” and together with Ajuba, the “Company”) and Devendra Saharia, who resides at 99 4" Street, Adithi (4C) Abiramapuram, Chennai 600 018 India (the "Employee"). The Company agrees to employ the Employee, and the Employee accepts employment on . terms and conditions set forth below.

name: 1.1 Board
text: 11. "Board" shall mean the Board of Directors of Ajuba.

name: 1.2 Business
text: 1.2 “Business” shall mean the activities engaged in by the Company and products and services of the Company provided at any time during the Employment Term to hospitals, physicians and such other entities serviced by the Company at any time during the Employment Term in the United States and India, including but not limited to claims processing, billing, _. insurance. verification, eligibility, pre-authorization,. insurance. coding,..credit. balance-resolution,. . - accounts receivable management, bad debt collections, cash posting, denials.and appeals, zero - balance analysis, underpayment analysis, provider enrollment, inbound and outbound call center services, audits, consulting, data entry, data capture and data conversion of health insurance claims and other related services.

name: 1.3 Code
text: 1.3 "Code" shall mean the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended from time to time.

name: 1.4 Company Technology
text: 1.4 “Company Technology” shall: mean ideas, concepts, know-how, works of authorship and inventions, drawings, schematics, and improvements and modifications thereof, patentable or unpatentable, copyrightable or non-copyrightable known to the Employee as a consequence of or through the Employee’s employment with the Company and which relate to the Business.

name: 1.5 Confidential Information
text: 1.5 “Confidential Information” shall mean .all information, in whatever form, regarding Parent, the Company their Business and their clients, including, without limitation, information relating to: (i) the formulas, products, design, manufacture, methods, application, know-how, research, development and processes of the Business; (ii) sources of supplies and materials; (iii) operating and other cost data; (iv) lists of present, past and prospective clients, and credit and financial data concerning such clients; (v) client proposals; (vi) price lists and data relating to pricing of the Company’s products or services; (vii) sales activities, procedures, and techniques; (viii) computer programs; (ix) third-party licensed programs and (x) data bases.

name: 1.6 Core Business
text: 1.6 “Core Business” shall mean that portion of the Business which (a) is provided to hospitals or physicians or other entities related to the healthcare industry serviced by the ‘Company at any time during the Employment Term, or (b) either (i) accounted for more than one percent (1%) of Ajuba’s actual consolidated gross revenue in the then preceding 12-month period, or (ii) which is covered by a new contract signed but not fully ramped up prior to the I ~~ 2:11-cv-12936-MOB-LJM Doc#11-3 Filed 10/17/11 Pg 3o0f22 PgID170 _ termination of employee, if the scheduled first-year gross revenue (based on the actual contract terms) would account for more than the sum of (A) one percent (1%) of Ajuba's actual consolidated gross revenue in the then preceding 12-month period and (B) the scheduled first- _ year gross revenue for such new contract.

name: 1.7 Customer
text: 1.7 “Customer” shall mean (a) a client of the Parent, or of the Company or its subsidiaries, (b) an entity which was a client of Parent, the Company or its subsidiaries at any — time during the six (6) month period prior to the date of termination of this Agreement or (c) an entity which was actively sought by Parent, the Company or its subsidiaries as a prospective client and with whom the Employee had material contact while an employee of the Company during the twelve (12) month period prior to the date of termination of this Agreement.

name: 1.8 EBITDA
text: 1.8 “EBITDA” shall mean net income plus, to the extent deducted in calculating net income, interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization determined for Ajuba and its subsidiaries, on a consolidated basis, in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles consistently applied for any fiscal year, as determined by reference to the components set forth in Ajuba’s audited financial statements for such Fiscal Year. In the event of any dispute regarding the calculation of EBITDA for any fiscal year, the independent accountants regularly employed by Ajuba for such Fiscal Year shall resolve such dispute.

name: 1.9 Employment Term
text: 1.9 “Employment Term” shall commence on the Effective Date and shall terminate on the third anniversary of this Agreement, unless earlier terminated pursuant to Article VIII of this Agreement.

name: 1.10 Fiscal Year
text: 1.10 “Fiscal Year" shall mean the 12-month period beginning on January 1 and ending on the next subsequent December 31, or such other 12-month period as may constitute Ajuba's fiscal year at any time hereafter.

name: 1.11 Parent
text: 1.11 “Parent” shall mean MiraMed Global Services, Inc., a Delaware corporation.

name: 1.12 Person
text: 1.12 “Person” shall mean any corporation, company, partnership, other entity or individual.

name: 1.13 Restricted Area
text: 1.13 “Restricted Area” shall mean the United States, its territories and protectorates . and India.

name: 1.14 Restricted Period
text: 1.14 “Restricted Period” shali mean the’ period commencing on the date of this Agreement and ending on the date that is three years after the end of the Employment Term.

name: 2.1 Employment of the Employee
text: 2.1 Employment of the Employee. Effective on the date of this Agreement, Ajuba India employs the Employee as President of Ajuba India. The Employee shall also hold the title of President-International for Ajuba. In such capacities, the Employee shall perform the duties as are customarily performed by a President as further set forth on Schedule 2.1, and such other legally permissible and proper duties as may be assigned from time to time by the Board and which are consistent with Employee’s services provided to the Company prior to the date hereof or with Employee’s position. Employee acknowledges that the duties set forth in Schedule 2.1 2 ~ 2:11-cv-12936-MOB-LJM Doc#11-3 Filed 10/17/11 Pg4of22 PgID171_ are consistent with the Amended and Restated Bylaws of the Company; provided that in the event of any conflict between Schedule 2:1 and the Bylaws, Schedule 2.1 shall control. Schedule 2.1 shall be deemed to have been amended in the event of any consolidation, elimination or outsourcing of those functions described in Section 8.4(a). Employee agrees to comply with all of the Company’s policies, standards and regulations as promulgated by the officers of the Company and to follow the instructions and directives of the Board. Employee shall report directly to the Board (or selected designee of the Board of Directors of the Parent). Employee shall devote his full professional and business-related time, skills and best efforts to such duties on behalf of the Company and will not, during the Employment Term be engaged (whether or not during normal business hours) in any other business or professional activity, including consulting services, writing opportunities or speaking engagements other than on behalf of the Company, whether or not such activity is pursued for gain, profit or other pecuniary advantage, ‘without the prior written consent of the Board. Notwithstanding the foregoing and subject to the limitations of Article V, Employee may (a) make and manage passive personal investments, (b) serve in any capacity with any civic, educational, or charitable organization or serve as a board member to any Person not in competition with the Business, as shall be disclosed to the Board, and (c) engage in such other business activities as the Board shall have approved in advance i in writing.

name: 2.2(a) Salary
text: (a) Salary. During the Employment Term, Ajuba India shall pay to Employee, as compensation for his services to the Company, an annual salary (“Base Salary”) equal to $250,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2005 and $270,000 for each fiscal year for the remainder of the Employment Term, provided that if Ajuba’s EBITDA equals or exceeds $3.5 million, then the Base Salary shall increase to $300,000 retroactive to the first business day of the year following the Fiscal Year in which such EBITDA was achieved. Employee, in lieu of receiving health, dental and other benefits afforded to Ajuba US employees, shall receive an additional $18,800 -annually (“Allowance”). The Base Salary and Allowance shall be processed once per month in accordance with Ajuba India’s general payroll practices.

name: 2.2(b) Annual Bonus
text: (b) Annual Bonus. During the Employment Term, the Employee shall be _ ¢ligible to receive an annual cash bonus as set forth below (“Bonus”): Fiscal Year 2005. EBITDA Bonus $3.5 million OO $ 50,000 $3.75 million | $ 75,000: $4.0 million $100,000 Fiscal Year 2006 EBITDA Bonus $4.5 million $ 50,000 $5.0 million — -§$ 75,000 $5.5 million $100,000 ~ 2:11-cv-12936-MOB-LUM Doc#11-3 Filed 10/17/11” Pg 5 of 22° Pg ID 172™ Fiscal Year 2007 EBITDA Bonus $6.0 million $ 50,000 $6.5 million $ 75,000 $7.0 million $100,000 If the Employee is entitled to receive a Bonus for any Fiscal Year, such Bonus shall be paid by Ajuba India within thirty (30) days of receipt of the audited financial statements of Parent but in no event later than June 30 of the following Fiscal Year. Any Bonus payable with | respect to a portion of the 2005 Fiscal Year shall be prorated from the period of the Effective Date to December 31, 2005. The Bonus for Fiscal Year 2007, if payable, shall be paid to the Employee if the Employee remains employed by the Company pursuant to the terms of this Agreement through the entire Employment Term, unless such employee is terminated pursuant to Sections 8.3 or 8.4 after December 31, 2007 and prior to the date of payment.

name: 2.2(c) Benefits
text: (c) Benefits. During the Employment Term, the Employee shall be entitled to participate in all employee benefit plans and programs that are made available to the Company's _ OS - Senior executives or to its Employees generally, as such plans or programs may be in effect from time to time. It is understood that such benefits may be-modified or discontinued at the sole discretion of the Company, unless precluded by law.

name: 2.2(d) Director and Officer Liability Coverage
text: (d) Director and Officer Liability Coverage. At all times during the _ Employment Term, the Company shall maintain, and Employee shall be covered by, a directors and officers liability insurance policy (“D&O Policy”) substantially similar to the D&O Policy maintained by the Company immediately prior to the date hereof.

name: 2.2(e) Commissions
text: (e) | Commissions. Provided that the Employee is employed by the Company as of the Payment Date (as defined below), as hereafter described, the Employee shall be entitled to a commission for contracts which are signed by the Company during the twelve month period after the Effective Date which are generated by the Company, by the Employee or by Samii (the “Eligible Contracts”). No commission shall be payable for any contracts referred to the Company by Parent or any of its subsidiaries (other than the Company) or affiliates (including Tony Mira). The commission will be paid by Ajuba India on the second regularly scheduled pay day of each month (“Payment Date”) as follows: (x) 1.5% of the net sales for the prior month if the Eligible Contract was generated by the sales force of the Company and such sales force is entitled to a commission therefor and (y) 3% of the net sales for the prior month if the Eligible _ Contract was generated by the Employee or Samii and if the Company does not otherwise pay a commission for such contract. With respect to each Eligible Contract, the Commission would no longer be payable following the twelfth month after the Eligible Contract “goes live”.

name: 2.2(f) Reorganization Bonus
text: (f Reorganization Bonus. The Employee shall receive $200,000 when and if . the Company’s UK office is shut down and the Company’s Novi office is restructured, each in _ accordance with Schedule I attached hereto which sets forth the specific cost savings for each action and a reasonable risk assessment for each recommendation in regard to client retention and service performance for its U.S.-based clients (the “Reorganization Bonus”). If the 4 — 2:11-cv-12936-MOB-LJM Doc#11-3 Filed 10/17/11 Pg6 of 22 PgID173 ~ foregoing actions have been completed, the Reorganization Bonus will be paid by Ajuba India on the twelve month anniversary of the Effective Date provided the Employee is either employed by the Company as of the date of payment or had been terminated by the Company pursuant to Section 8.3 or 8.4 after the Reorganization Bonus was earned and prior to the date of payment.

name: 2.3 Expense Reimbursement
text: 2.3 Expense Reimbursement. During the Employment Term, the Employee shall be entitled to reimbursement by the Company, in accordance with Company policies, for all reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred by him in performing services under this Agreement, upon his submission of such accounts and records as may be reasonably required by the Company.

name: 3.1 Confidentiality
text: 3.1 Confidentiality, The Employee agrees to keep confidential all Confidential Information, and in any event shall not now or at any future time, directly or indirectly, use, publish, divulge, reproduce, transmit, or provide the Confidential Information or any portion thereof to any entity, except (a) as. the Company may expressly authorize in writing; (b) for Confidential Information which subsequently becomes part of the public domain (other than as a result of a breach of this Agreement by Employee); (c) for Confidential Information which Employee rightfully received from a party other than the Company, any affiliate of the Company or any of its shareholders, employees, agents or representatives; or (d) to the extent disclosure is required by law. 7

name: 3.2 Return of Confidential Information
text: 3.2 Return -of Confidential Information. | Employee acknowledges that all Confidential Information is and shall remain the property of the Company. Accordingly, Employee further agrees that upon Employee’s termination of employment with the Company, the Employee shall return to the Company all Confidential Information now or hereinafter in the possession, custody, or control’ of Employee, including any tangible reproductions or copies thereof and shall permanently delete or destroy all electronically stored copies.

name: 3.3 Company Obligation
text: 3.3. Company Obligation. The Company agrees not to disclose the terms and conditions of this Agreement except for legitimate business purposes.

name: 4.1 Ownership and Assignment
text: 4. Ownership and Assignment. Upon the Company’s request and to the extent permitted by law, Employee shall assign to the Company all rights, title and interest of Employee, if any, in and to the Company Technology, including, without limitation, all inventions, improvements, technical information and suggestions relating in any way to the Business which Employee has conceived, developed or acquired during the Employment Term (whether or not during usual working hours), together with all patent applications, letters patent, copyrights and reissues thereof that may at any time be granted for or upon any such invention, improvement or technical information. Employee further agrees to execute any documents the Company deems reasonably necessary to evidence the Company’s rights, title and interest in the Company Technology and the assignment by Employee of all rights, title and interest in the Company Technology.

name: 4.2 Return of Company Technology
text: 42 Return of Company Technology. Employee acknowledges that all Company Technology is and shall remain the property of the Company. Accordingly, Employee further agrees that upon the Employee’s termination of employment with the Company, Employee shall retum to the Company all Company Technology now or hereinafter in.the possession, custody, or control of Employee, including any tangible reproductions or copies thereof and shall not thereafter be permitted to use any Company Technology and shall permanently delete or destroy _ electronically stored copies.

name: V(a) Noncompetition
text: Employee acknowledges the competitive nature of the Company’s business and, accordingly, agrees to the following: | (a) Duririg the Restricted Period and within the Restricted Area, Employee shall not, directly or indirectly (other than on behalf of the Company or its subsidiaries or affiliates), engage. in any activity which is in competition with the Business whether such engagement is as an officer, director, proprietor, employee, partner, investor (other than as a holder of less than 2% of the outstanding capital stock of a publicly traded corporation), consultant, advisor, agent, representative or otherwise.

name: V(b) Non-solicitation of Customers
text: (b) During the Restricted Period, the Employee shall not, directly or indirectly other than on behalf of the Company or its subsidiaries or affiliates, (i) induce any Customer to _ patronize any business directly or indirectly in competition with the Business; (ii) canvas, solicit or accept from any Customer any such competitive business, or (iii) request or advise any Customer, or any of their affiliates, to withdraw, curtail or cancel any Customer’s business with the Company or Parent or their affiliates.

name: V(c) Non-solicitation of Employees
text: (c) During the Restricted Period, the Employee. shall not, directly or indirectly, recruit, solicit or otherwise induce or influence: any employee, sales agent, or consultant of the Company (other than on behalf of the Company or its subsidiaries or affiliates), or any person who served as such at any time during the six months prior to termination of Employee’s employment, to discontinue such employment, agency, or consultant relationship with the company or its subsidiaries or affiliates, or, with respect to any employee in the United _ States or any employee in India having the title of Supervisor and above, employ or seek to employ, or cause any business which competes directly or indirectly with the Company to employ or seek to employ any employee, sales agent, or consultant of the Company or any of its subsidiaries. The preceding sentence does not, however, prohibit the Employee from placing general advertisements for employees in India below the title of Supervisor in newspapers or other media of general circulation, provided that no employee of the Company is hired in violation of the preceding sentence.

name: V(d) Core Business substitution
text: (d) Notwithstanding anything in this Section V to the contrary, in the event the Employee’s employment is terminated pursuant to Section 8.4 of this Agreement, then for purposes of subsection (a) above only, the term “Business” shall be replaced with the term “Core - Business”.

name: V(e) Acknowledgment of Reasonableness
text: (ce) Employee acknowledges that the above restrictions contained in this Section are reasonable in scope and duration and are necessary to protect the legitimate business interests of the Company.

name: 6.1 Contracts
text: 6.1 Contracts. The Employee represents and warrants that, except for this Agreement or as disclosed to the Company in writing, the Employee is not a party or otherwise subject to any contract, agreement, or arrangement, whether written or oral, related to: (i) the nondisclosure of confidential information of any entity or person; (ii) the proprietary rights in, and ownership of, ideas, concepts; know-how, works of authorship, inventions, and improvements and modifications thereof, patentable or unpatentable, copyrightable or noncopyrightable; or (iii) a covenant, agreement, or commitment by the Employee not to compete with any entity or person.

name: 6.2 No Violation of Other Agreements
text: 6.2 No Violation of Other Agreements. The Employee represents and warrants that the Employee’s execution and delivery of this Agreement and performance of the Employee’s obligations hereunder, and performance of the Employee’s employment obligations and duties while employed at'the Company, do not, and will not, violate the terms of any other contract, agreement, or arrangement, whether written or oral, to which the Employee is a party or otherwise subject to, including, without limitation, any non-compete or confidentiality agreement _ between the Employee and a former employer.

name: VII. Remedies
text: The Employee acknowledges that the Company’ s remedy at law for a breach or threatened breach of any of the provisions of Articles I, IV or V would be inadequate. In recognition of this fact, in the event of a breach by Employee of any of the provisions of Articles -. IW, IV or V, Employee agrees that, in addition to the Company’s remedy at law and the Company’s rights under Article VII hereof, the Company shall be entitled to obtain equitable relief in the form of specific performance, temporary restraining order, temporary or permanent injunction or any other equitable remedy which may then be available and the Company will not be obligated to post bond or other security in seeking such relief. Nothing herein contained shall be construed as prohibiting the Company from pursuing any other remedies available to it for such breach or threatened breach. If any portion of the above restrictions are deemed overbroad or unenforceable in any respect, the parties agree that the court shall modify such restriction(s) so that it is reasonable and shall enforce the restriction(s) as so modified.

name: 8.1 Termination
text: 8.1 Termination. Employee’s employment will terminate on the earliest of the third anniversary of the Effective Date or the first to occur of the events set forth in Sections 8.2 through 8.5.

name: 8.2 Cause
text: 8.2 Cause. The Employee’s employment under this Agreement may be terminated by the Company for “Cause.” The following shall constitute “Cause” for termination: er ~ 2:11-cv-12936-MOB-LJM Doc# 11-3” Filed 10/17/11” Pg 9 of 22™ Pg ID 176 (a) . An act of fraud or embezzlement, misappropriation (which shall not include incidental .personal use of supplies), conduct causing the Company or its subsidiaries substantial public disgrace or disrepute, a violation of governmental laws applicable to the Company or its subsidiaries in his capacity as an officer or employee of the Company or its subsidiaries, conviction for any crime punishable as a felony or a gross misdemeanor; (b) failure in any material respect to perform his duties and responsibilities consistent with the provisions of Section 2.1 hereof, | (c) breach of any of the provisions of Articles I, IV, V or VI of this Agreement, (d) or failure to reside in India for the Employment Term, unless otherwise agreed to by the Company. © Prior to a determination of Cause pursuant to Section 8.2, the Board shall give Employee notice of its intent to terminate the Employee’s employment for Cause, an opportunity to be heard and an opportunity to cure such failure within the fifteen (15) day period following the Employee’s receipt of such notice. If the Employee’s employment under this Agreement is terminated by the Company for Cause, the Company shall continue to be liable only for the Base Salary, if any, with respect to periods of time prior to the date of such termination and the Company shall not have any liability. for any other bonus or other compensation pursuant to Section 2 of this Agreement for either the prior or current year. Ajuba India may pay such compensation, in the _ sole discretion of the Board, in a lump sum within ten (10) days of the date of termination or over time in accordance with Ajuba India's usual payroll practices. Employee shall have no right to participate in the Company's benefit plans subsequent to the date of termination for Cause unless required by any state or federal laws or regulations.

name: 8.3 Death and Disability
text: 8.3 Death and Disability. The Company may terminate the Employee’s employment in the event of Employee’s “Disability” and employment will terminate automatically upon Employee’s death. “Disability” shall be deemed to exist if Employee has substantially failed to perform his essential duties under this Agreement for one hundred twenty (120) days in any two. hundred forty (240) day period for reasons of mental or physical health (as determined by competent medical evidence) with or without reasonable accommodation. Employee's employment shall terminate for Disability effective upon notice by the Company to Employee, of such termination. If the Employee’s employment under this Agreement is terminated for any reason set forth in this Section 8.3,.the Company shall continue to be liable for the Base Salary, . if any, with respect to periods of time prior to the date of such termination and except as expressly set forth in this Section 8.3, the Company shall not have any liability for any other bonus or other compensation pursuant to Section 2 of this Agreement for either the prior or current year. Ajuba India may pay such compensation, in the sole discretion of the Board, in a lump sum within ten (10) days of the date of termination or over time in accordance with Ajuba India's usual payroll practices. If, at the time of termination, the Employee was employed by the Company as of the last day of the prior Fiscal Year and a Bonus was earned, then the Employee ' Shall be entitled to receive the Bonus for such prior Fiscal Year when otherwise payable in accordance with Section 2.2(b). If at the time of termination, the Reorganization Bonus had been earned but not paid, then the Employee shall be entitled to the Reorganization Bonus when 8 2:11-cv-12936-MOB-LUM Doc#11-3 Filed 10/17/11 Pg 10 of 22 “Pg ID 177 otherwise payable in accordance with Section 2.2(e). Employee and/or his estate shall have no right to participate in the Company's benefit plans subsequent to the date of termination for any reason set forth in this Section 8.3 unless required by any state or federal laws or regulations.

name: 8.4 Without Cause; Good Reason
text: 8.4 Without Cause; Good Reason. The Company may terminate the Employee’s employment for any reason other than the reasons listed in Sections 8.2 and 8.3 or for no reason. Employee shall have the right to terminate his employment with the Company for Good. Reason or for any other reason pursuant to this Section 8.4. Employee shall have Good Reason to’ terminate his employment hereunder if his termination shall be the result of: (a) A material diminution during the first year of this Agreement in the Employee’s position, duties, authority or responsibilities as outlined in Section 2.1 without Employee’s consent provided, however, the consolidation (other than with another officer of the Company), elimination (including with the Parent) of or outsourcing of cash management (other than the management of working capital, including payment of current liabilities in the ordinary course), accounting and sales and marketing functions shall not constitute a material diminution hereunder,; i (b) ‘Parent removes the Employee as a member of the Board prior to the first anniversary of this Agreement without Employee’s consent; or _ : oo, (c) A breach. by the Company of the compensation and benefit provisions of Section 2,2 or 2.3 hereof. _ If the Employee’s employment under this Agreement is terminated pursuant to this Section 8.4 by the Company or for Good Reason by the Employee, Ajuba India shall pay the Employee, upon execution without revocation of a Separation Agreement and Release of Liability Agreement in favor of the Company in the form attached hereto, the compensation at the rate or level, as applicable, in effect on the date of such termination, through the third anniversary of the Effective Date, less any amounts owing by the Employee to the Company. Ajuba India may pay such severance compensation over time in accordance with the Company's usual payroll practices, or Ajuba India may prepay such compensation at such times and in such ' amounts as the Board, in its sole discretion, shall determine. If, at the time of termination, the Employee was employed by the Company as of the last day of the prior Fiscal Year and a Bonus _- Was earned pursuant to Section 2.2(b), then the Employee shall be entitled to receive the Bonus for such prior Fiscal Year when otherwise payable in accordance with Section 2.2(b). If at the time of termination, the Reorganization Bonus had been earned but not paid, then the Employee shall be entitled to the Reorganization Bonus when otherwise payable in-accordance with Section 2.2(e). Employee shall have no right to participate in the Company's benefit plans subsequent to the date of termination pursuant to this Section 8.4 unless required by any state or federal laws or regulations. Employee acknowledges that the Company will not be in breach of this Agreement if, after the first year anniversary of the Effective Date, the title of Employee is changed from that of President-International of Ajuba and/or President of Ajuba India to another position provided that such title is not lower in the organization than Senior Vice President.

name: 8.5 Termination By Employee
text: 8.5 Termination By Employee. The Employee may terminate his employment with the Company for any reason. The Employee shall: give the Company notice of voluntary 2:11-cv-12936-MOB-LJM Doc# 41-3 Filed10/17/41 Pg 110f22 PgID178 termination of employment, which notice need specify only the Employee’s desire to terminate employment. Any notice by the Employee pursuant to this Section 8.5 shall be effective as of a date chosen by the Company, however, no later than thirty (30) business days after the date the Company receives such notice. If the Employee terminates his employment pursuant to this Section 8.5, Ajuba India shall pay to the Employee, the Base Salary, if any, with respect to periods of time prior to such date of termination. Ajuba India may pay such compensation, in the sole discretion of the Board, in a lump sum within ten (10) days of the date of termination or over time in accordance with Ajuba India's usual payroll practices. Employee shall have no right to participate in the Company's benefit plans subsequent to the date of termination pursuant to this Section 8.5 unless allowed by any state or federal laws or regulations. The Company shall not have any liability for any other bonus or other compensation pursuant to Section 2 of this + Agreement for either the prior or current year.

name: 9.1 Section and Other Headings
text: OI Section and Other Headings. The sections and other headings contained in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not be deemed to control or affect the meaning or interpretation of any provision of this Agreement.

name: 9.2 Severability
text: 9.2 Severability. In the event that any provision or portion of this Agreement shall be determined to be invalid or unenforceable for any reason, in whole or in part, the remaining provisions of this Agreement shall be unaffected thereby and shall remain in full force and effect: to the fullest extent permitted by law.

name: 9.3 Waiver
text: 9.3 Waiver. No delay or failure on the part of the Company in exercising its rights under this Agreement, and no partial or single exercise of such rights, shall constitute a waiver of tights contained in this Agreement on a future occasion.. Any waiver of rights ‘under this Agreement shall be effective only in the specific instance and for the specific purpose for which such written waiver was given.

name: 9.4 Assignment
text: 9.4 Assignment. This Agreement may not be assigned by the Employee, but may be assigned by the Company only (a) in the event that the Company shall be merged with, or consolidated into, any other entity, to the surviving entity, or (b) in the event that the Company shall sell. and transfer substantially all of its assets to, or shall become a subsidiary of, another entity, to such entity. Except as herein provided, and to the extent permitted by law, this Agreement will be binding upon and will benefit the parties and their respective heirs, successors, assigns, and personal representatives.

name: 9.5 Notices
text: 9.5 Notices. Any notice permitted or required to be given under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed properly given when delivered either personally, by fax, by overnight delivery service (such as Federal Express) or sent by certified or registered mail postage prepaid, return receipt requested, duly addressed to the appropriate party at the address indicated below or to such changed address as a party may subsequently give notice of. name: 9.6 Withholding Taxes
text: 9.6 Withholding Taxes. All payments to the Employee under this Agreement shall be subject to withholding on account of federal; state and local taxes as required by law.

name: 9.7 Survival
text: 9.7 Survival. Any termination of this Agreement shall not affect the ongoing provisions of this Agreement, which shall survive such termination in accordance with their terms.

name: 9.8 Entire Agreement
text: 9.8 Entire Agreement. This Agreement contains the entire agreement and understanding of the parties and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous agreements, arrangements, and understandings relating to the subject matter of this Agreement except for that certain Non-Competition Agreement of even date herewith to which Employee is also subject. No representation, inducement, agreement, promise, or understanding altering, modifying, amending, taking from or adding to, the terms and conditions hereof shall have any force or effect unless the same is in writing and validly executed by each of the parties hereto. Without limiting the foregoing, the Employee acknowledges that he is not a party to any other employment agreement with the Company or its subsidiaries.

name: 9.9 Third Party Beneficiary
text: 99 Third Party Beneficiary. This Agreement is not intended to confer, and shall not be deemed to confer, upon any person other than the Parties any rights or remedies under this Agreement except that Parent shall be deemed a third party beneficiary hereunder.

name: 9.10 Governing Law
text: 9.10 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws and decisions of the State of Michigan without regard to its conflict of laws. principles.

name: 9.11 Counterparts
text: 9.11 Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which when so executed and delivered shall be an original, but all such counterparts together shall constitute one and the same instrument.

name: 9.12 Nonalienation of Benefits
text: 9.12 Nonalienation of Benefits. Except as may be contrary to applicable law, no sale, transfer, alienation, assignment, pledge, collateralization or attachment of any benefits under this Agreement shall be valid or recognized by the Company.

name: 9.13 Non-Disparagement
text: 9.13 Non-Disparagement. . During the Employment Term and thereafter, each party agrees not to disparage the other party, their respective affiliates or their respective officers, directors or employees

name: 9.14 Board
text: 9.14 Board. Employee agrees that if he is a member of the Board at any time as the Board is taking action with respect to this Agreement, he will recusé himself from that portion of the meeting in which such actions are to be taken.

name: 9.15 Venue
text: 9.15 Venue. Any action or proceeding seeking to enforce any provision of, or based on any right arising out of, this Agreement may be brought against any of parties in the courts of the State of Michigan, County of Jackson, or, if it has or can acquire jurisdiction, in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan, and each of the parties consents to the jurisdiction of such courts (and of the appropriate appellate courts) in any such action or proceeding and waives any objection to venue laid therein, Process in any action or proceeding referred to in the preceding sentence may be served on any party anywhere in the world.

name: Exhibit A - Recitals
text: THIS SEPARATION AGREEMENT AND RELEASE (“Release”) is made by and among (“Employee”) and Ajuba International, Inc. and Ajuba Solutions (India) Pvt Ltd (the “Company”). Collectively, Employee and Company are referred to as the “Parties.” oO RECITALS A. Employee and Company were parties to an Employment Agreement (“Employment Agreement”) entered into on _ . B. D. Employee and Company, without any admission of liability, desire to settle with finality, compromise, dispose of, and release any and all claims and demands asserted or which could be asserted arising out of Employee’s employment at band separation from Comnipany. eis consideration of the foregoing and of the promises and mutual covenants contained herein, it is hereby agreed between Employee and Company as follows:

name: Exhibit A - 1. Complete Release
text: 1. Complete Release. In exchange for the good and valuable consideration set forth in the Employment Agreement, entered into between the Parties, Employee hereby releases, waives and. discharges the Company, and its parent, subsidiary, associated and affiliated companies, and successors and assigns, and its and their directors, officers, employees, agents -- and attorneys, past, present and future, from any and all manner of action, causes of action, claims, rights, charges, suits, damages, debts, demands, obligations, attomeys fees, and any and all other liabilities or claims of whatsoever nature, whether in law or in equity, known or unknown, as a result of or relating to Employee’s employment at and separation from the Company and as an officer of Company including, but not limited to, age discrimination under the Age Discrimination In Employment Act of 1967, as amended (ADEA), employment discrimination prohibited by other federal, state or local laws, including any violation of Title - VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (ERISA), the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (ADA), the Older Workers Benefit Protection Act (OWBPA), the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), the Occupational and Safety Health Act (OSHA) and the Equal Pay Act, and any other claims, which Employee has claimed or may claim or could claim in any local, state or federal or other forum, claims as a result of any acts or omissions by the Company, and claims of breach of contract, wrongful discharge, and violation of Company rules, policies and procedures, which occurred up to the date of this Agreement; excluding only those to compel the payment of amounts due to Employee as provided in the Employment Agreement.

name: Exhibit A - 2. Return of Company Property
text: 2. Return of Company Property. Employee agrees to immediately return to Company all property, assets, manuals, materials, information, notes, reports, agreements, memoranda, customer lists, formulae, data, know-how, inventions, trade secrets, processes, techniques, and all other assets, materials and information of any kind or nature, belonging or pertaining to Company (“Company Information and Property”), including, but not limited to, computer programs and diskettes or other media for electronic storage of information containing Company Information and Property, in Employee’s possession, and Employee shall not retain copies of any such Company Information and Property. Employee further agrees that from and after the date hereof he will not remove from Company’s offices any Company Information and Property, nor retain possession or copies of any Company Information and Property.

name: Exhibit A - 3. Non-Disparagement
text: 3. Non-Disparagement. For so long as Employee holds Restricted Stock Units, he agrees that he shall never make any statement that negatively affects the goodwill or good reputation of the Company, or any officer or director of the Company, except as required by law, and except that such statements may be made to members of the Board. The Company agrees that in response to inquiries from Employee’s prospective employers it will not disclose the circumstances of Employee’s resignation or the terms of this Agreement. Employee shall direct all inquiries regarding Employee’s employment to Tony Mira. Although the Company cannot control what is said by its employees, agents and other associated with it, it agrees to issue no official company statements regarding Employee that would negatively affect the goodwill or good reputation of Employee and will use its best efforts to ensure that no person, on behalf of the Company, makes any such statement regarding Employee.

name: Exhibit A - 4. Not Seek Employment
text: 4. Not Seek Employment. To never seek or accept employment with Company. To ensure that the purpose of this provision is accomplished, Employee waives any claim ‘in connection with any future refusal by the Company to employ him.

name: Exhibit A - 5. Continuing Obligations
text: 5. Continuing Obligations. Employee understands and agrees that his obligations — - concerning confidential information, proprietary rights and non-competition and restricted business activities, as set out in his Employment Agreement, continue after his termination and are not affected by the execution of this Agreement.

name: Exhibit A - 6. Assistance in the Defense of Claims
text: 6. Assistance in the Defense of Claims and Consultative Advice. The Employee agrees, upon reasonable notice from the Company, to assist the Company in the defense of any legal or administrative proceeding now pending or which later may be filed by or against the Company or - by or against any affiliated or related companies or any of their officers, directors or employees. The Company will reimburse and/or advance monies to the Employee for lost wages and out-ofpocket expenses (including reasonable attorneys’ fees) incurred in connection with such assistance. The Employee agrees, in addition, to the extent requested from time to time by the Company and provided such requests do not require more than a reasonable amount of the Employee’s time, to provide telephonic consultative advice with respect to questions the Company may have regarding matters for which the Employee previously had responsibility or otherwise possess knowledge.

name: Exhibit A - 7. No Current Litigation
text: 7. No Current Litigation. Employee acknowledges that he has not commenced any action or claim against Company.of any nature, including but not limited to the types of actions or claims set forth in paragraph 1, above.

name: Exhibit A - 8. Right to Consult Counsel
text: 8. Right to Consult Counsel. Employee understands and agrees that he was advised to consult with an attorney and did so prior to executing this Agreement.

name: Exhibit A - 9. Review Period
text: 9.. Review Period. Employee understands and agrees that he has been given twentyone (21) days within which to consider this Agreement before signing it.

name: Exhibit A - 10. Employee's Right to Revoke Agreement
text: 10. Employee’s Right to Revoke Agreement. Employee understands and agrees that he may revoke this Agreement for a period of seven (7) calendar days following the execution of this Agreement (the “Revocation Period”). This Agreement is not effective until this revocation period has expired. Employee understands that any revocation, to be effective, must be in writing and either (a) postmarked within seven (7) days of execution of this _ Agreement and addressed to . or (b) hand delivered within seven (7) days of execution of _ this Agreement to . | , Employee understands that if revocation is made by mail, mailing by certified mail, return receipt requested, is recommended to show proof of mailing.

name: Exhibit A - 11. Commencement of severance payment(s)
text: li, Commencement of severance payment(s). Employee agrees that the Company’s obligations are contingent upon Employee (a) signing this Agreement, (b) not exercising his revocation rights, and (c) providing the Company with written confirmation that he has not exercised his revocation rights.

name: Exhibit A - 12. Understanding of Agreement and Voluntary Execution
text: 12. Understanding of Agreement and Voluntary Execution. Employee further agrees that he has read this Agreement carefully and understands all of its terms. In agreeing to sign this Agreement, Employee is doing so completely voluntarily and of his own free-will and without any encouragement or pressure from Company and agrees that in doing so he has not relied on any oral statements or explanations made by Company or its representatives.

name: Exhibit A - 13. Non-Disclosure
text: 13. Non-Disclosure. Employee agrees not to disclose tlie terms of this Agreement to any third party, except as is required by. law, or as is necessary for purposes of securing counsel from Employee’s attorney or accountant. The Company agrees to disclose the terms of this - Agreement only for legitimate business purposes.

name: Exhibit A - 14. Non-Admission of Liability
text: 14. Non-Admission of Liability. This Agreement shall not be construed as an admission of wrongdoing by Company or Employee.

name: Exhibit A - 15. Entire Agreement
text: 15. Entire Agreement. This Agreement contains the entire agreement between — Employee and Company regarding the matters set forth herein, Any modification of this Agreement must be made in writing and signed by Employee and the Company.

name: Exhibit A - 16. Newly Discovered Facts
text: 16. Newly Discovered Facts. Employee may hereafter discover facts different from or in addition to those he now knows or believes to be true, and he acknowledges that this Agreement shall be and remain in effect in all respects as complete as to the matters to be released, notwithstanding any such different and additional facts.

name: Exhibit A - 17. Applicable Law
text: 17. Applicable Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the domestic laws of the State of Michigan, without giving effect to any choice _of law or conflict of law provision or rule (whether of the State of Michigan or any other 16 " 2:11-cv-12936-MOB-LJM Doc#11-3 Filed 10/17/11 Pg%9o0f22 PgID186 ~ jurisdiction) that would cause the application of the laws of any jurisdiction other than the State of Michigan.

name: Exhibit A - 18. Severability
text: 18. Severability. In the event any provision of this Agreement or portion thereof is found to be wholly or partially invalid, illegal or unenforceable in any judicial proceeding, then such provision shall be deemed to be modified or restricted to the extent and in the manner necessary to render the same valid and enforceable, or shall be deemed excised from this Agreement, as the case may require, and this Agreement shall be construed and enforced to the maximum extent permitted by law, as if such provision had been originally incorporated herein as so modified or restricted, or as if such.provision had not been originally incorporated herein, as the case may be::

name: Exhibit A - 19. Consequences of Employee Violation of Promises
text: 19. Comsequences of Employee Violation of Promises. In the event that Employee _ violates the terms of this Agreement, in addition to other available rights and remedies, the Company shall be released of all of its remaining obligations under the Severance Agreement,
